entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-28
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • MSBuildWorkspace.OpenSolutionAsync raise exception (sample project to reply issue here) #83925

Updated

  • [Known Build Error] Razor AddImport code action not found in CodeAction tests #83775

    Backlog

    18.3

    18.9
